Definition: to alight; (transitive) to cause to descend, i.e. drive down
BiblicalUsage: tsânach describes to alight. It appears 3 times in Scripture, including Joshua 15:18 and Judges 4:21.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe tsânach belongs in His Word because the idea it carries belongs there.
